title: Formation with Roundels
description: Four SKILCRAFT compact discs are mounted across a dense collage featuring top-down and side-view warplane silhouettes, layered over gold foil, iridescent plastic, and painted marks. Concentric roundels and numbered target rings run along the lower register, anchoring the composition.
composition: layered planes and discs over foil ground
keywords: numbered concentric rings gold foil collage
